hooks.command: f=$(jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // .tool_response.filePath // empty'); case "$f" in "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR"/*) ;; *) exit 0 ;; esac; cd "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR" || exit 0; [ -x node_modules/.bin/prettier ] || exit 0; node_modules/.bin/prettier --write --ignore-unknown --log-level warn "$f" >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
